observed: The structural local-scale posterior reproduced across PyMC and NumPyro.
The hard scale-threshold router abstained for all 27 subjects.
The adaptive prior closed less than one percent of the future pointwise oracle gap.
The targeted local perturbation ranked first but missed its frozen magnitude threshold by 0.0143333333.
failure_translation.formal_mismatch: Pr(kappa_i < c | D) is not equivalent to Pr(L_local,i < L_pool,i | D).
failure_translation.successor_principle: Infer a posterior field of cross-fitted predictive regret. Treat structural shrinkage quantities as whitebox covariates, never as the decision itself.

dataset_lottery.ordering_rule: case-insensitive lexicographic order of canonical package::dataset identifiers

temporal_constitution.fit_job_rule: Confirmatory fitting jobs may see Days 0 through 7 only. Days 8 and 9 must be absent from their checkout.
temporal_constitution.router_freeze_rule: Router architecture, features, thresholds and meta-priors freeze after calibration and before future unsealing.
temporal_constitution.final_refit_rule: After router freeze, component policies may refit on Days 0 through 7 without changing their prior programs; the router may update only inputs explicitly declared as state estimates.

scientific_object.name: Decision-Coupled Prior Authority Field
scientific_object.unit: subject x forecast horizon x prior program
scientific_object.cross_fitted_regret: r_i,h,m = loss_i,h,m - min_m' loss_i,h,m' using exact rolling refits
scientific_object.regret_model: hierarchical Bayesian model with subject, horizon and program effects plus training-only whitebox covariates
scientific_object.policy_weights: posterior softmax of negative predicted regret
scientific_object.forbidden_shortcut: PSIS-based unit routing is not admissible when any relevant Pareto k exceeds 0.7; exact rolling refits are required.

component_policies.P1_GLOBAL_POOL: Gaussian hierarchical random intercept and slope in an orthonormal sum-zero basis.
component_policies.P2_GLOBAL_LOCAL: Regularized global-local random intercept and slope with sum-zero projection.
component_policies.P3_LOW_POOL: Frozen broad random-effect scales, serving as an executable low-pooling baseline.
component_policies.P4_STACKED_MIX: Training-only Bayesian stacking mixture over P0-P3, with weights generated by the regret field.

action_field.separation_from_q4: Action states are not epistemic Q4 states and confer no authority by themselves.
action_field.POOL: posterior probability that P1 has at least epsilon lower regret than every non-pool policy is at least 0.80
action_field.LOCAL: posterior probability that the best of P2/P3 has at least epsilon lower regret than P1 is at least 0.80
action_field.MIX: posterior probability that P4 has at least epsilon lower regret than every component is at least 0.80
receipt_requirements: expected regret and interval for every policy
all feature values and evidence cuts

primary_claim: A cross-fitted posterior regret field can assign unit-local pooling, local autonomy, model mixture or abstention under a fixed evidence cut, improve future log score relative to the best aggregate prior program, and close a nontrivial fraction of the pointwise oracle gap without sacrificing PPL conformance or authority discipline.
